title: Transfer: Coastal Sensor Procurement Frontier
goal: Evaluate candidate coastal buoy sensor bundles, discard options below the minimum shoreline coverage requirement, and save the Pareto-optimal set balancing expected annual coverage and total 3-year cost to `/root/procurement_frontier.csv`.
skillBenefitRationale: 关键在于识别采购方案中的非支配组合，处理覆盖率最大化与成本最小化的冲突目标；计算本身只是直接读取和比较表格字段。
